raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Summary At decode batch sizes, GLM-5.3-Flash's mHC boundaries are small, latency-bound launches. The attention -> FFN boundary inside a layer is already fused (`hc_ffn_post_pre`); this does the same for the layer -> layer boundary. - Each layer's FFN `hc_post` is deferred. Its coefficients stay on the layer's `MHCState` until the next layer's attention read fuses them with that layer's `hc_pre` (`hc_attn_post_pre`). - It reuses the existing post+pre fusion path and its 16-token cap. Larger batches fall back to the unfused post, then pre. - The last layer still writes back and contracts the streams itself. - It is gated by the existing `SGLANG_OPT_FUSE_MHC_POST_PRE`, and off under PP > 1, TBO and `--enable-attn-tp-input-scattered`. - The rejections of attention-CP and MoE-CP gathers, and of input-scattered attention under CP, now key on any non-plain FFN update, so they also cover the deferred one. - `hc_ffn_post_pre` and `hc_attn_post_pre` share one helper. ## Results GLM-5.3-Flash on 4x GB300, TP4. Before is main; single runs. GSM8K: 97.50% before, 97.65% after. Decode, 8K input and 1K output: | Concurrency | Output tok/s | Median TPOT (ms) | Median TTFT (ms) | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | 196 -> 202 (+3.0%) | 4.85 -> 4.71 (-2.9%) | 245 -> 241 | | 2 | 353 -> 361 (+2.2%) | 5.24 -> 5.11 (-2.5%) | 444 -> 449 | | 4 | 606 -> 619 (+2.0%) | 5.89 -> 5.76 (-2.2%) | 746 -> 742 | | 8 | 990 -> 1000 (+1.0%) | 7.07 -> 6.99 (-1.1%) | 1056 -> 1052 | | 16 | 1490 -> 1517 (+1.8%) | 9.14 -> 8.95 (-2.1%) | 1662 -> 1659 | | 32 | 2165 -> 2163 (-0.1%) | 11.96 -> 11.96 (0.0%) | 2868 -> 2878 | TPOT drops 1-3% up to 16 concurrent requests, where each decode step fits the fused boundary. At 32 it matches main. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :x: [Run #38109251837](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38109251837) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #38109251650](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38109251650) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #38109251856](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38109251856)
